principle1Title: Human Leads. AI Operates. System Learns.
principle1Text: The owner sets direction and approves. AI agents prepare the work. The system records what happened.
principle2Text: A finished task is not a verified result. We show what was done and what was confirmed.
ctaText: Choose a task with a clear owner, a clear scope and a result you can confirm. Try NIVO OS and see how it runs.
ctaNote: Sign in and explore a ready-made workspace. Trial terms are confirmed by the NIVO team.
ctaMascotAlt: NIVO unicorn pointing to the start button
a1: NIVO OS is an operating system for founder-led service businesses. Every piece of work has one accountable owner, one clear next step and evidence of the result. Your team and AI agents work together in one Office.
q2: Can the AI send messages to customers by itself?
a2: No. AI agents prepare drafts and suggest next steps. The owner approves, edits or rejects before anything leaves the company, and the system records the decision.
q3: What is included, and what do I buy?
a3: Sales Agent and Accounting Agent come with your workspace. The Chatbot is an agent you buy from the catalog, set up and test before it starts capturing website leads.
a4: {percent}% off for the first {cap} SMEs that start with NIVO before {date}. Final terms are confirmed by the NIVO team.
q5: What data does NIVO use, and where does it live?
a5: The product you see here is a trial workspace with sample data. The production data policy, including access, export, storage and deletion, is confirmed during onboarding, before you connect real data.
a6: Sign in, open the trial workspace and follow one lead from the Chatbot to Sales, to your approval, to the invoice. Then pick one real task to try.
a7: The pricing snapshot shows {plan} at {price} per month after a {days}-day trial. The final price and terms are confirmed by the NIVO team before you start.
q8: Does NIVO guarantee that customers buy or pay?
a8: No. Whether a customer buys or pays depends on many factors. NIVO shows who owns each task, what happened and what evidence exists, so you can act on facts.
